name: test-app-dwi2b0
summary: Test registration of dwi2b0: extracts the b0 volumes from a DWI series with MRtrix3 and outputs their mean or, optionally, an ANTs rigid b0 template.
description: Test copy of the dwi2b0 App registered on the same branch (v0.2). Runs MRtrix3 dwiextract -shell 0 to pull out the non-diffusion-weighted volumes, then averages them with mrmath or, when template is set, builds a rigid-only ANTs template. Prefer the main dwi2b0 App for production use; the input DWI needs at least one b=0 volume.

inputs.description: 4D diffusion-weighted image with its bvals and bvecs.
inputs.requirements: Must contain at least one b=0 volume.

outputs.description: The mean non-diffusion-weighted (b0) image was generated by averaging all b0 volumes.
The 4D volume is constructed by concatenating all of the b0 images from the diffusion-weighted imaging series.

parameters.description: When this option is enabled, a b0 template is generated instead of computing a simple voxel-wise average of the b0 volumes.
